environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: Every proxy branch connects to the configured upstream list or upstream backend server port; there is no variable proxy_pass and no request-derived port anywhere in the 12 sources. The Q7 confused-deputy SSRF shape therefore reduces to the configured upstream itself; a real unreachable-peer proof needs a network namespace the container does not grant (unshare -n returned Operation not permitted).
findings.title: Proxy always dials the configured upstreams; no client-controlled dial target exists

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
methods: Control request first on the same config
Raw client bytes and raw upstream bytes captured in hex
Payload diffed against the control line
